name: VRM_FMV_DATA_SET_USAGES
description: VRM_FMV_DATA_SET_USAGES contains price basis data sets used for fair market value calculation process.

columns.name: FMV_DATA_SET_USAGE_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier of a data set usage.  It will be used to derive the price basis data sets used in price calculation.

columns.name: FMV_LINE_SET_ID
columns.description: Fair marker value set unique identifier.

columns.name: PRICE_BASIS_DATA_SET_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: DATA_SET_TYPE
columns.description: Identifier of data set type used to derive the FMV value . Valid values are VSOE and ESP.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: FMV_LINE_ID
columns.description: Fair Market Value line unique identifier.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Document line unique identifier.

columns.name: NET_LINE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Net line amount used to calculate the VSOE value.

columns.name: NET_UNIT_SALES_PRICE
columns.description: Net unit sales price used to calculate the VSOE value.

columns.name: NET_UNIT_SALES_PCT_BASE_PRICE
columns.description: Net unit sales price used to calculate the VSOE value.

columns.name: NET_DISCOUNT_PERCENT
columns.description: Net discount percent used to calculate the VSOE value.

columns.name: REVISED_COST
columns.description: Revised cost used to calculate the VSOE value.

columns.name: REVISED_GROSS_MARGIN_PERCENT
columns.description: Revised gross margin percent used to calculate the VSOE value.

columns.name: EXCLUSION_STATUS
columns.description: Exclusion status to indicate line used to calculate VSOE value calculation. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: NET_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Net discount amount used to calculate the VSOE value.

columns.name: REVISED_UOM
columns.description: Unit of Measure used to calculate the VSOE value.

columns.name: NET_QUANTITY
columns.description: Net quantity used to calculate the VSOE value.

columns.name: BASE_PRICE
columns.description: Base price used to calculate the VSOE value.

columns.name: EXCLUSION_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Exclusion reason to exclude a line from VSOE value calculation. Values are from the lookup VSOE_PBL_EXCLUDING_REASON.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Comments entered to exclude a line.

columns.name: EXCLUDED_BY
columns.description: User who excluded the standalone sale.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation unique identifier.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_LINE_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation line unique identifier.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_NUMBER
columns.description: Customer contract number.
